title: Ship v9.8 Production Execution Go/No-Go Evidence Candidate
description: Ship v9.8 by bundling the existing provider execution readiness chain into an operator-facing production go/no-go evidence candidate that makes approval, target operation, reproduction, rollback, outcome, learning, incident recovery, cost/quota, product value, and not-proven boundaries inspectable without authorizing live provider execution.
triage_notes: v9.8 closes the gap between many provider readiness artifacts and one human production go/no-go candidate; the candidate is evidence for judgment, not permission to execute.
